text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day at training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You sure are focused, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If I'm remembering right, Grandma's
coming to
see your next race, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is why I intend to run the best
race I can
for her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Why did you have to come out
today?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I wonder what the all commotion is
about?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, you said that today's race is
important to
you, so...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: It is! It's a scrimmage and a bunch of trainers will be there!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
If you're there, then... I'll be too
embarrassed to
run properly!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry... I'll be off then, so good
luck with
your race, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what her deal is. Sounds like
she was
arguing with her mom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Any mom who would show up to watch
their kid's
scrimmage is cool in my
book...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you wanna go and have a chat with
her?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Do you have a sec? What was all that
with your
mom just now?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, uh... My mom came to cheer
me on for
my scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
But, like... I don't think I can run
properly if she's
around...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-well, you know! It's kinda
embarrassing! You
see where I'm coming
from, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Do you really find your mother's support

embarrassing?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure you're not simply afraid
you won't
live up to her expectations?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You should know that your mother is
your first
fan and biggest supporter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She would never be disappointed in you,
no
matter the result.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The important thing to do is to show
your mother
your best efforts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is what it means to race for your
fans.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: My... my number one fan!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um... thank you so much! Mooom, wait
up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'm positive she'll show her
mother a
wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I too must put my best foot
forward!
It's back to training for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll show Grandma an
awesome race
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but of course. As I've said before,

expectations don't scare me. They only
serve to
make me stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, I have to get back to
training...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! If you wanna race with all you've
got for
Grandma, then you've gotta give
in to a craving
or two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... I guess I'm not as focused as I

thought...
